sections.tldr: Dayananda Sagar University Online MBA at a glance: UGC-DEB approved, NAAC A+, Not listed in NIRF 2025, 2 years (4 semesters), Rs 1,30,000 total fee, 8 MBA electives: Financial Management, Human Resource Management, Marketing Management, IT & Systems Management, Supply Chain Management, Entrepreneurship Management, Business Analytics and Artificial Intelligence. Learners take one major and one minor. Best for working professionals in Bengaluru and South India seeking an online MBA at Rs 1.3 lakh with electives such as AI, Business Analytics or Supply Chain Management.

hero.headline: Dayananda Sagar University Online MBA, Not listed in NIRF 2025, NAAC A+, Rs 1.3L

The 2-year programme offers 8 electives, taken as one major and one minor: Financial Management, Human Resource Management, Marketing Management, IT & Systems Management, Supply Chain Management, Entrepreneurship Management, Business Analytics and Artificial Intelligence.

about.heading: About Dayananda Sagar University Online MBA
about.body: Dayananda Sagar University (DSU) is a private university established by a Karnataka State Act, located in Bengaluru, Karnataka. It holds NAAC A+ accreditation. EdifyEdu verifies these accreditation figures independently and does not receive commission from this university. The online MBA offers 8 electives: Financial Management, Human Resource Management, Marketing Management, IT & Systems Management, Supply Chain Management, Entrepreneurship Management, Business Analytics and Artificial Intelligence. Learners take one major and one minor. The total programme fee is Rs 1,30,000, published as four semester amounts.

approvals.heading: UGC-DEB Approval and Accreditations
approvals.body: Dayananda Sagar University holds NAAC A+ accreditation (naac.gov.in) and is not listed in NIRF 2025 overall ranking (nirfindia.org). DSU is a private university (not deemed-to-be university) and the online MBA is delivered under UGC-DEB entitlement (deb.ugc.ac.in), AICTE approval does not apply to online MBA programmes here, since AICTE approval is required only for deemed-to-be universities running online management programmes. UGC-DEB approval is the relevant regulator for this degree and it makes the programme valid for government jobs, PSU recruitment, and higher education admissions in India. Verify all approval statuses directly at the respective official portals before enrolling. Accreditation grades and UGC-DEB entitlements are reviewed annually.

ugcDeb.heading: UGC-DEB Approval and Degree Validity
ugcDeb.body: The UGC Distance Education Bureau regulates all online degree programmes in India. The UGC-DEB register at deb.ugc.ac.in lists Dayananda Sagar University for the Master of Business Administration in Online mode for the 2026-27 session (checked 18 November 2026). This entitlement means: the degree is valid for government job applications at central and state levels, graduates can pursue higher education at recognised Indian universities, and PSU recruitment boards accept the degree under current UGC norms. The register is updated each session, so check it again for your own admission year before enrolling.

whoCanApply.heading: Who Can Apply
whoCanApply.body: DSU asks for a bachelor's degree of at least 3 years with not less than 50% aggregate in all years; SC, ST and OBC candidates need 45% (checked 18 November 2026). No entrance exam is required for admission. Work experience is not mandatory. Create your Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) ID at abc.gov.in before applying.

classes.heading: Class Schedule and Delivery
classes.body: Dayananda Sagar University Online MBA is delivered through the DSU Online learning management system. DSU runs live sessions at weekends and adds pre-recorded sessions and self-paced modules. Assignment submission windows are fixed per semester, but daily study scheduling within those windows is flexible.

exams.heading: Examination Mode
exams.body: All examinations for the Dayananda Sagar University Online MBA are conducted online in a proctored format. A functioning webcam, valid government-issued photo ID, and a stable internet connection are required. DSU weights continuous internal assessment (CIA) and the semester-end examination (SEE) 30:70. All 8 electives follow the same examination structure. Keep Aadhaar as your primary ID for exam sessions.

specializationsOverview.heading: MBA Specialisations at Dayananda Sagar University
specializationsOverview.body: Dayananda Sagar University Online offers 8 MBA electives: Financial Management, Human Resource Management, Marketing Management, IT & Systems Management, Supply Chain Management, Entrepreneurship Management, Business Analytics and Artificial Intelligence. Learners take one major and one minor. Operations Management and International Business are Semester 2 core courses, not electives. For subject lists by elective, visit the spec pages on this site.

syllabusNote.heading: Dayananda Sagar University Online MBA, Curriculum Overview
syllabusNote.body: DSU publishes its full MBA curriculum with course codes (checked 18 November 2026); it states no version or year. Semester 1 (23 credits): Accounting for Managers, Marketing Management, Human Resource Management, Organisational Behaviour, Information Systems, Statistics for Managers, Business Economics and Policy, and Business Communication-I. Semesters 2 to 4 and every elective are listed on DSU's MBA page. Our counsellor can share the official list for your electives.

fees.heading: Fee Structure, Dayananda Sagar University Online MBA
fees.body: The total fee for the Dayananda Sagar University Online MBA is Rs 1,30,000. DSU publishes it as four semester amounts, with an annual option, and the fee table on this page lists each line as published. The examination fee and the one-time, non-refundable processing fee sit inside the semester amounts. A one-time, non-refundable application fee is paid separately and is not in the total. Fees are consistent across all 8 electives. Fees listed are indicative. Reconfirm current fees with our counsellor before making any payment to the university.

coupon.heading: Scholarships and Fee Concessions
coupon.body: DSU's MBA page and portal FAQ publish no scholarship, fee concession or discount amount (checked 18 November 2026). Ask the admissions team in writing whether any concession applies to you before you pay.

emi.heading: EMI Options
emi.body: DSU's MBA page publishes no EMI figure (checked 18 November 2026). If you want to pay in instalments, ask the admissions team in writing which plans exist, their tenure and any interest. DSU does publish a semester-wise and an annual payment option.

sampleCert.heading: Degree Certificate
sampleCert.body: Graduates receive a degree certificate issued by Dayananda Sagar University under UGC-DEB guidelines. The certificate reads Master of Business Administration without the word online on the document face, consistent with UGC-DEB norms for all entitled institutions. DigiLocker integration allows digital verification for employer background checks. Physical certificates are dispatched after convocation.

admission.heading: Admission Process
admission.body: Step 1: Visit the official Dayananda Sagar University Online admissions portal and navigate to the MBA programme page. Step 2: Register with your email address and mobile number. Step 3: Fill the application form and select your preferred MBA specialisation from the 8 available tracks. Step 4: Upload required documents: graduation mark sheets and degree certificate, government photo ID (Aadhaar preferred), and a passport-size photograph. Step 5: Pay the one-time, non-refundable application fee to initiate document verification. Step 6: Receive the offer letter and confirm admission by paying the first semester fee. Intake windows typically open in January and July. Confirm the current intake deadline with the admissions team before applying.

abcId.heading: Academic Bank of Credits (ABC ID)
abcId.body: The Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) ID is mandatory for online programme enrolment at UGC-DEB entitled universities, including Dayananda Sagar University Online. Create your ABC ID at abc.gov.in before completing admission. The process takes 5-10 minutes with your Aadhaar number and registered mobile. Have your ABC ID number ready during the application, DSU Online requires it at the time of admission confirmation.

beyondAdmission.heading: Beyond Admission, What edifyedu.in Offers
beyondAdmission.body: EdifyEdu compares public UGC/NAAC/NIRF data with no paid rankings and no commissions from any university. After reading this page, you can: compare Dayananda Sagar University Online side-by-side with peer universities at /compare; request the specialisation-wise syllabus from our counsellor at /contact (shared within 24 hours); or book a free call to clarify fee, scholarship, and admission timeline questions. Our counsellors do not push you toward any specific university.

comparisons.heading: Dayananda Sagar University vs Peer Online MBA Universities
comparisons.body:
Dayananda Sagar University Online: NAAC A+, Not listed in NIRF 2025, Rs 1,30,000, 8 electives taken as a major and a minor.

Amity University Online: NAAC A+, NIRF University #22, Rs 1.15L-2.25L, 12 specialisations. Higher NAAC grade and NIRF rank at comparable fee. Choose Amity if NIRF top-30 and NAAC A+ are priorities.

Galgotias University Online: NAAC A+, not NIRF-ranked, Rs 80,200, 7 specialisations. Significantly cheaper but no NIRF rank.

Use the compare tool at /compare to evaluate side by side.

honestVerdict.heading: Honest Verdict, Dayananda Sagar University Online MBA
honestVerdict.body:
This verdict is based on publicly available data from UGC-DEB, NAAC, and NIRF portals, cross-referenced with programme information.

Choose this if:
- NAAC A+ at a Rs 1,30,000 total fee is strong value for your career needs
- An AI, Business Analytics, Supply Chain or Entrepreneurship elective matches your career direction
- You are based in Bengaluru or South India

Look elsewhere if:
- You need NIRF top-30 and your employer enforces this threshold
- Electives beyond the 8 on offer are needed
- Placement support with a verifiable track record for online students is a non-negotiable requirement

If you are undecided, our counsellor call is free at /contact.

redFlags.heading: Red Flags to Know Before You Enrol

flags.sentence1: DSU charges a one-time, non-refundable application fee that is not part of its published total fee.
flags.sentence2: Budget for it on top of the total, and ask for a receipt that names each fee you pay.

flags.sentence1: Learners take one major and one minor from eight electives, so the pairing you want has to be open for your intake.
flags.sentence2: Confirm both electives in writing with the admissions team before you pay the first semester fee.

faqs.question: Is the Dayananda Sagar University Online MBA degree valid for government jobs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dayananda Sagar University is listed on the UGC-DEB entitled institutions list at deb.ugc.ac.in. The online MBA is valid for government job applications and PSU recruitment under current UGC norms. Verify the current entitlement at deb.ugc.ac.in for your specific admission year before enrolling.

faqs.answer: Yes. DSU runs live sessions at weekends and adds pre-recorded sessions and self-paced modules. All exams are online. No mandatory campus visits are required across the 8 electives. Assignment windows allow flexible daily scheduling.

faqs.question: How does Dayananda Sagar University Online MBA compare to Galgotias University Online MBA?
faqs.answer: Dayananda Sagar University Online: NAAC A+, Not listed in NIRF 2025, Rs 1,30,000, 8 electives taken as a major and a minor. Galgotias University Online: NAAC A+, NIRF Management 2025 band 101-125, Rs 80,200, 7 specialisations. Both hold NAAC A+. Choose DSU for its AI, Business Analytics and Supply Chain electives; choose Galgotias if the lower fee matters more.
